cupboard.definition: A tall box with doors. Dry food and clean dishes are kept inside it.
cupboard.example: The clean cups are in the cupboard.

fruit.definition: A part of a plant that holds seeds and is good to eat, like a mango or a pear.
fruit.example: A mango and a pear are both fruit.

inference.definition: Running a trained model to produce one answer. Cheap and fast compared with training, and it is what happens when you press send.
inference.example: Training cost a fortune; inference is what you pay for every time you use it.

sunlight.definition: The light that comes from the Sun. It looks white, but it holds all the colours of the rainbow.
sunlight.example: Sunlight is white until rain or mist splits it into colours.

vendor_lock_in.definition: The condition in which switching suppliers is so costly that dependence continues regardless of price or quality.
